title: review.json — agent-written review input
description: What the agent writes and post/record validate. Derived from validate_and_merge in scripts/review.sh and the review.json block in docs/manual.md: unknown schema_version refuses, missing warns; out-of-range confidence and non-string security_summary warn-and-drop; unknown anchor paths and non-numeric anchors are kept with a warning, provably-outside anchors move to the body; unknown rigor/severity values fall back (pointed/null). Unknown top-level keys are ignored by the script, so this schema allows them.

schema_version.description: Agents stamp "1"; post/record refuse anything else.

body.description: Full review text, verdict marker first line.

approved.description: Binding ask; the CLI --bind/--request-changes flags win over this.

resolved.description: Finding sigs (full or unambiguous prefix) the run addresses. Bare claims only record history; addressed needs verification.json evidence.

triage.description: Status claims with rationale. Unknown status refuses the run; unknown sig warns; rationale under 30 chars keeps the prior status.

sections.description: Severity tags for ### body sections; exact heading string, unmatched tags ignored.

confidence.description: Review-level certainty, integer 1-5; out-of-range warns and drops.

security_summary.description: One-paragraph security read; non-string warns and drops.

chunks.description: Coverage attestation on chunked bundles: every manifest chunk name the synthesis covers. Attested-but-partial coverage is refused.

path.description: Diff-relative path; unknown paths are kept with a warning, never refused.

line.description: NEW-side line; numeric strings anchor like integers, non-numeric anchors are kept with a warning.

start_line.description: Multi-line range start; same tolerance as line.

side.description: Defaults to RIGHT; case-insensitive, LEFT for deleted lines.

suggestion.description: Fenced suggestions demote to the body (a fence inside would break rendering).

rigor.description: Evidence rung; unknown values read as pointed.

severity.description: Stored at write time; unknown values read as null.

in-bounds.description: Hyphenated in agent input; absent reads true.

kb.description: Cited knowledge-base rule ids the script normalizes; malformed ids warn and drop.
